chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from a number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Hammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn al-Mukhtar, from Abu Basir, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'The sun does not rise on any day more superior than the day of Friday.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Friday in Shia Islam according to the hadith of Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Reported by Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith establishes Friday as the preeminent day of the week, a status rooted in the Shia tradition of associating it with the appearance of the Mahdi and the gathering of believers. This superior virtue serves as the theological basis for the specific recommended acts of worship and spiritual preparation emphasized in the chapter on Friday night and day.
